title: Open Tabular Insight Extraction: Where Do We Stand, and Where Should We Go?
abstract: arXiv:2609.07629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Democratizing access to the knowledge held in large corpora of tables such as data lakes is emerging as a central research challenge. Research in this space is advancing and broadening in scope, increasingly supplying the components to satisfy a person's insight need end-to-end. Yet these efforts remain fragmented across communities that frame the problem under their own conventions, such as table question answering, text-to-SQL, and data analysis agents, with works six times as likely to cite within the same task label as across labels. To bring these communities onto common ground, we establish a holistic framework for this pursuit, which we refer to as Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI). We formalize OpenTI from first principles around the analytical knowledge a person needs, the procedure for deriving it from a corpus of tables, and how well a result serves the person who sought it. translated_title: 开放表格洞察提取：我们身处何方，又将走向何方？
translated_abstract: 让大众能够便捷地获取数据湖等大规模表格语料库中所蕴含的知识，正日益成为一项核心研究挑战。该领域的研究正在不断推进并扩展范围，越来越多地提供满足用户端到端洞察需求的各个组件。然而，这些努力仍分散于不同的研究社区之中，各社区按照自身惯例来界定这一问题，例如表格问答、text-to-SQL以及数据分析智能体，同一任务标签内的引用可能性是跨标签引用的六倍。为了使这些社区找到共同基础，我们为这一研究方向建立了一个整体性框架，我们称之为开放表格洞察提取。我们从第一性原理出发对OpenTI进行形式化定义，围绕用户所需的分析知识、从表格语料库中推导该知识的过程，以及结果对寻求该知识的用户的服务质量。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“开放表格洞察提取”这一整体性框架，从第一性原理出发统一了表格问答、text-to-SQL和数据分析智能体等彼此割裂的研究社区，为从大规模表格语料库中端到端地提取人类所需的分析知识奠定了共同的理论基础。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI), a holistic first-principles framework that unifies fragmented research communities—such as table question answering, text-to-SQL, and data analysis agents—toward end-to-end extraction of human analytical insights from large corpora of tables.
